decision.msg: OrphanAsks is a subclass of UndoneToTasks (Server/OrphanAsks.mjs), not a --orphans mode: it reuses the homes scan, overlap match and the item-tool create, and adds only which asks (FollowUp's own list) and where (module home). Alternative: a mode flag inside UndoneToTasks, which would put two source shapes in one class. One edit to the base: create() takes caller from this.constructor.BY.

Orphan set = FollowUp.run().asks, so the plan and the follow-up page can never disagree. The ledger rows carry no module, so the home comes from the title label (OrphanAsks.HINTS), else word overlap with a module readme, else ai. Alternative: ask a model to route; rejected (law 7).

Already-tracked match uses the larger of two-way overlap and coverage of the ask's words by a task's title+description+request, over 60% and 3 shared words; this finds the 2 asks (UI System class, AI systems) a 10-17 task already holds. Alternative: two-way overlap only, which missed both because task descriptions are long.

Code merges from the worktree first; --apply then runs in the main tree (the ledger, manifest and task folders are records appended in place by Servex too), and those records are committed by exact path. Alternative: apply inside the worktree, which would conflict on the ledger tail.
